maya: Heads up: small release notes patch for docs v0.10.1. Need two quick edits: (1) update Go SDK snippet for streaming (we forgot Go in the last sweep), (2) append a one-line known-issue note about truncated streams with nested markdown lists. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2228

chris: I can add the Go example. Will mirror the async iterator via channels pattern. ETA: EOD.

kevin: For the known issue blurb, recommend wording: "Known issue: nested markdown lists in prompts can cause stream truncation. Workaround: flatten lists or use non-streamed call." Is that concise enough for the release note?

liz: Yep. Add reference to internal ticket INC-6042. Also please add a tiny test snippet for QA reproducer steps.

dev-docs-bot: Preview build for PR 2228: https://deploy-preview-2228--docs.redwood.ai (status: success)

maya: Thanks. Assigning: chris (go snippet), kevin (known-issue text + QA repro). I'll merge once PR includes both. Target: tomorrow morning.
